listings.name: CDS Ceiling and Drywall Supplies Pretoria Central
listings.current_description: CDS Ceiling and Drywall Supplies has operated since 2004 as a South African supplier of ceiling and drywall materials, including lightweight ceiling systems, drywall boards, gypsum products, and insulation, partnering with brands such as Gyproc, Hilti, and Isover. The company operates around 10 branches nationwide, including this Pretoria/Mayville location.

listings.name: CEEIT Solutions
listings.current_description: CEEIT Solutions is an IT services company based in Magalieskruin, Pretoria, operating since 1999 and offering POS and ERP systems, IT hardware, barcode and scanning systems, virtual servers, VoIP cloud PABX, cloud backup, and internet connectivity for small and medium businesses. It also has a branch serving the Western Cape.

listings.name: DCV Auditors
listings.current_description: DCV Auditors is a Centurion-based auditing, tax and accounting firm with roots going back to 1979 (established under its current name in 1984), having evolved from Dippenaar, Coetzee and Partners. It is a registered SAICA and SAIPA training office, and is affiliated with The Core Group network of accounting firms.

listings.name: Demwreck
listings.current_description: Demwreck is a South African drilling, blasting and demolition company serving the aggregate, quarrying and cement industries, offering contract drilling with laser leveling, turnkey rock-on-ground solutions, industrial demolition, and blast design and vibration monitoring. It has operated since 1994 and has worked with clients including Afrimat, Anglo American and Gautrain.

listings.name: Die Seep Winkel
listings.current_description: Die Seep Winkel is a cleaning products wholesaler and manufacturer in Elardus Park, Pretoria, open since 2006, selling household cleaning agents such as degreasers, dishwashing liquid, car cleaning products and washing powder, as well as raw chemicals, perfumes and dyes for customers who make their own soap and cleaning products.

listings.name: Eagle Liner - Head Office
listings.current_description: Eagle Liner operates semi-luxury intercity coach services connecting Pretoria with Johannesburg, Cape Town, Durban, Bloemfontein, East London and Gqeberha, among other destinations, with online and WhatsApp booking and a BusBucks loyalty rewards program. Its head office is in Raslouw, Centurion, and it also offers a premium service called Intercity Xpress.

listings.name: Invicta Construction CC
listings.current_description: Invicta Construction CC is a building and construction company established in 1996 and registered with the NHBRC, which has focused on affordable sectional title developments since 2005 and has built and sold more than 900 residential units, alongside general building, renovation, plastering, painting and tiling work from its Waverley base.

listings.name: Le Roux & Du Plessis Attorneys
listings.current_description: Le Roux & Du Plessis Attorneys is a niche law firm in Eldoraigne established in 2001, specialising in family law (divorce, and child and spouse maintenance), property law including conveyancing, and High Court litigation, with additional expertise in commercial law, business rescue, employment law, estate planning and liquidation and sequestration.

listings.name: LTG Logistics Transport Globally Rosslyn
listings.current_description: LTG Logistics Transport Globally is a freight forwarding and clearing company based in Rosslyn, established in 2006 originally to serve the automotive supply chain and since expanded into mining, engineering, agricultural, perishable and general freight, handling sea and air freight, imports, exports and cross-country distribution for over 100 permanent clients.

listings.name: Meet the Minis
listings.current_description: Meet the Minis runs regular hands-on interactions with a herd of miniature horses on a farm off the R513, where visitors can brush and dress up the minis, cuddle foals, walk with the horses, use a putt-putt course and splash pool, and meet resident goats and bunnies, with bookings essential.

listings.name: Mega Books
listings.current_description: Mega Books, in Faeriedale Shopping Centre in Faerie Glen, is one of South Africa's largest second-hand bookstores, stocking over 2km of shelving and importing around 40,000 books every third month from Canada, the United States and England, while donating roughly half of its stock to charities, schools and churches.

listings.name: Modern Office
listings.current_description: Modern Office, based in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, is an office furniture supplier with more than 20 years of experience, part of the Esaaks Office Furniture family, offering ergonomic chairs, executive desks, boardroom and training room furniture and storage solutions, both locally manufactured and imported, with delivery and installation across Gauteng.

listings.name: Olympus Manor Estate Venues
listings.current_description: Olympus Manor Estate Venues is an events and function venue in Olympus, Pretoria, set on a 2-hectare property with a banquet hall, ballroom and several outdoor garden venues. It hosts weddings, conferences and private functions for groups of 10 to 400 guests, with on-site accommodation for up to 40 people.

listings.name: Philton Leather
listings.current_description: Philton Leather has operated in Waltloo for over 30 years, supplying a curated range of high-quality Italian leather hides imported directly from Italy alongside precision laser and blade cutting services for leather and textiles. The business also produces automotive upholstery kits, with each kit cut, stitched and finished to order.

listings.name: Phoenix Industrial & Safety Suppliers Pretoria
listings.current_description: Phoenix Industrial & Safety Suppliers has operated in Gezina, Pretoria since 1993, starting out supplying cleaning rags to Gauteng industries and growing into an ISO-accredited manufacturer of cleaning rags, safety footwear, hard hats and a full range of industrial safety products for the engineering, construction, petrochemical, security and mining sectors.

listings.name: Portuguese Hall
listings.current_description: Portuguese Hall, run by the Association of the Portuguese Community of Pretoria in Proclamation Hill, is a multi-purpose venue with a large function hall seating around 1,000 people plus an indoor and outdoor soccer field, and its restaurant serves traditional Portuguese and continental dishes for lunch, dinner and catering.

listings.name: VZLR Inc
listings.current_description: VZLR Inc is a multi-disciplinary law firm with over 80 years of combined legal experience, offering banking and financial law, conveyancing, corporate and commercial law, family law, litigation, insurance law, intellectual property, labour law, medical law, personal injury, and wills and estates services from branches in Pretoria, Johannesburg and Nelspruit.

listings.name: Africa Wildlife Tracking
listings.current_description: Africa Wildlife Tracking is a Rietondale-based company designing and manufacturing GPS wildlife tracking devices -- including collars, ear tags and horn implants -- along with receivers, towers and satellite systems and a software dashboard, used by conservationists to monitor species such as rhino, lion, pangolin and elephant and support anti-poaching efforts.

listings.name: Afrit Parts & Accessories - Rosslyn
listings.current_description: Afrit Parts & Accessories is the Rosslyn parts and accessories division of Afrit, Africa's largest trailer manufacturer, which has built trailers -- including side-tippers, end tippers, tankers and car carriers -- for more than 60 years from a 78,000 square metre Rosslyn plant producing over 6,000 trailers a year.

listings.name: BBD Steel Suppliers
listings.current_description: BBD Steel Suppliers is a woman-owned steel supplier in Rosslyn -- its name derived from the Setswana "Basadi Ba Ditshipi", meaning women in steel -- serving as Allied Steelrode's exclusive distributor for the Rosslyn area and supplying precision pre-cut steel and aluminium parts to automotive manufacturers, certified to ISO 9001:2015.

listings.name: BuildVolume Pretoria
listings.current_description: BuildVolume Pretoria is South Africa's official supplier of 3D printers and related equipment from brands including Bambu Lab, Ultimaker and Formlabs, based at Boardwalk Office Park in Faerie Glen, Pretoria. It sells printers and consumables, provides local technical support and demo units, and runs a training facility at its Pretoria headquarters.

listings.name: Cafe 41 Groenkloof
listings.current_description: Cafe 41 Groenkloof began as a small local coffee shop opened by Helen and Minas Ioannou and has grown into one of Pretoria's well-known restaurants, serving European-inspired breakfasts, gourmet burgers, salads and pasta alongside coffee and a wine list that won Diners Club Best Wine List awards between 2007 and 2013.

listings.name: Centurion Cricket Company
listings.current_description: Centurion Cricket Company (Cricket Company) is an online retailer of cricket and hockey equipment - bats, pads, gloves, helmets, apparel, and accessories from brands including Gunn & Moore, Gray-Nicolls, Kookaburra, and Grays - with additional physical stores at stadiums such as SuperSport Park, the Wanderers, and Newlands, and nationwide courier delivery.

listings.name: CyteSpace Africa (Pty) Ltd an MLM Company
listings.current_description: A clinical research pathology laboratory in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, operating since 1999 and providing chemistry, haematology, flow cytometry, immunoassay, microbiology and TB testing services for drug development; it holds College of American Pathologists accreditation as the first such lab in Africa and was acquired by MLM Medical Labs in June 2025.

listings.name: Digital Squad
listings.current_description: Digital Squad is an SEO-focused digital marketing agency offering keyword research, on-page and technical optimisation, link building, local SEO, and website design, with client work spanning industries such as construction, healthcare, and professional services. Their own website lists a Cape Town base, though this directory listing gives an Eldoraigne, Centurion address.

listings.name: EZY Switchgear
listings.current_description: EZY Switchgear specialises in medium- and high-voltage (MV/HV) electrical systems, offering switchgear repair, refurbishment and sales, a PowerSwap equipment trade-in program, an Islanding Controller for embedded generation, an EZY-VS voltage sensor system for 6.6-33kV ranges, and MV cabling, testing and preventative maintenance. The company is based in Daspoort, Pretoria.

listings.name: Ford Motor Company
listings.current_description: Ford Motor Company of Southern Africa operates its Silverton assembly plant here, in continuous operation since 1967, producing the Ford Ranger and Mazda BT-50 pickups for the local market and export to more than 100 countries, following a R15.8 billion expansion that added a new stamping plant and body shop.

listings.name: Gigajoule
listings.current_description: Gigajoule Group is a clean-energy investment company operating from Highveld Techno Park, developing piped gas distribution and a gas-fired power station in Mozambique through its Matola Gas Company subsidiary, and has supported industrial gas users in the region including a scrap steel smelter, medicine manufacturer and cooking oil distiller since 2005.

listings.name: IoT.nxt
listings.current_description: IoT.nxt, founded in late 2015 and headquartered in Doringkloof, develops an Internet of Things software platform serving the mining, smart spaces, telecommunications, manufacturing and utilities sectors, with integrated gateway technology that bridges different industrial protocols into a single integration point; Vodacom acquired a 51% stake in the company in 2019.

listings.name: KM Chartered Accountants (South Africa)
listings.current_description: KM Chartered Accountants (South Africa) is a professional accounting and audit firm established in 2010, offering bookkeeping, tax and financial statement services to clients ranging from small businesses to large corporations and government entities. The firm is an accredited SAIPA training office that also runs an internship programme for aspiring accountants.

listings.name: Malanseuns Wholesale Nursery
listings.current_description: Malanseuns Wholesale Nursery traces its roots back to 1913, when it began as a fruit-producing farm north of Pretoria before expanding into ornamental garden plants; today it wholesales trees, shrubs, edibles and herbs, indigenous plants, roses and seedlings to the trade, delivering by road across South Africa and to neighbouring countries.

listings.name: QUASAR HOLDINGS
listings.current_description: Quasar Holdings is a Montana Park-based company specialising in commodity trading, nutritional products and business consultation, sourcing and supplying agricultural and food commodities through long-standing relationships with suppliers and commercial farmers, and offering nutritional products for children and expectant mothers under its DaNutri100 brand, with additional offices in Sandton and Botswana.

listings.name: S4 Integration Pretoria
listings.current_description: S4 Integration Pretoria is the Pretoria branch of an industrial automation and software integration company, delivering production lines, special-purpose machines, warehouse management and ERP software, AGVs/AMRs and material handling systems for automotive, packaging, warehousing and food & beverage clients. The company has operated since 1996 and holds ISO 9001 accreditation.

listings.name: Astron Energy Monument Park
listings.current_description: Astron Energy Monument Park is a fuel station at the corner of Elephant and Skilpad Road, Monument Park, Pretoria, part of the Astron Energy network -- the brand that has been rebranding South Africa's former Caltex service stations since 2021, after Astron Energy took over the Caltex licence from Chevron in 2018.

listings.name: Astron Energy Sinoville
listings.current_description: Astron Energy Sinoville is a fuel station at the corner of Sefako Makgatho Drive and Albrecht Street, Sinoville, Pretoria, part of the Astron Energy network -- the brand that has been rebranding South Africa's former Caltex service stations since 2021, after Astron Energy took over the Caltex licence from Chevron in 2018.

listings.name: Aurecon South Africa
listings.current_description: Aurecon South Africa is an engineering and infrastructure advisory firm headquartered at the Aurecon Centre, Lynnwood Bridge, Pretoria (previously known as Africon), offering environmental management, infrastructure advisory, integrated planning, building design, ground engineering and asset management services; its Lynnwood Bridge building achieved a 4-star GreenStar SA rating for office design in 2011.

listings.name: BERG Off-Road
listings.current_description: BERG Off-Road is a South African manufacturer of premium off-road caravans, founded in 2023 and building every caravan from scratch at its Koedoespoort factory with aluminium frames, composite body panels and heavy-duty Burquip suspension; in under three years it has delivered more than 62 units across South Africa, Namibia, Botswana and Zimbabwe.

listings.name: Blue Crane Restaurant
listings.current_description: Blue Crane Restaurant, next to the Austin Roberts Bird Sanctuary in Nieuw Muckleneuk, serves sushi, seafood, and steaks across settings including a tea garden for breakfast and afternoon tea, a Top Deck with African Mask Bar overlooking the sanctuary's lakes, and a boma with bonfire seating, and hosts weddings and corporate functions.

listings.name: Brenthurst Wealth
listings.current_description: Brenthurst Wealth is a wealth management firm with an office in Erasmuskloof, Pretoria, providing independent investment advice covering investment planning, retirement planning, offshore investments, tax planning, estate planning and risk planning. It is an authorised Financial Services Provider (FSP No. 7833) established in 2004, with offices across South Africa and in Mauritius.

listings.name: CPM Projects CC
listings.current_description: CPM Projects CC is a building and construction company based in Silverton, Pretoria, established in 1997, offering turnkey commercial, residential and medical construction, embassy renovations and security upgrades, architecture and interior design, and project management. The firm holds a CIDB Level 7 rating and belongs to the Master Builders Association and NHBRC.

listings.name: DDP Property Valuations Gauteng - Head Office
listings.current_description: DDP Property Valuations is a nationwide valuation firm headquartered in Menlyn, Pretoria, offering residential, commercial, industrial, agricultural and retail property valuations as well as legal valuations for divorce and deceased estate matters, GRAP-compliant municipal valuations, and property fund valuations. Founded in 2003, the firm is SACPVP-registered and a Level 1 B-BBEE contributor.

listings.name: DNA EOR
listings.current_description: A Pretoria-based Employer of Record and HR outsourcing provider, DNA EOR, that helps international companies employ remote South African talent through Employer of Record, independent-contractor, PEO, payroll-outsourcing and BPO/call-centre services, with offices in Pretoria and Cape Town serving clients in the UK, Netherlands, US, Ireland, Germany, Spain, New Zealand and India.

listings.name: LMV ATTORNEYS | PRETORIA
listings.current_description: LMV Attorneys is a women-owned law firm in Rietfontein, founded by a practising attorney with rights of appearance in the High Court of South Africa and local Magistrates' Courts, offering services in deceased estates, wills and trusts, family law and divorce, criminal law, commercial law, construction law, property law and notarial work.

listings.name: Moolman Group
listings.current_description: Moolman Group, based in Lynnwood Ridge, Pretoria, is a property investment, development and management company founded in 1967 in Polokwane, managing more than 750,000 square metres of retail, commercial and industrial space -- including regional shopping centres, CBD buildings and warehouses -- with developments in seven of South Africa's nine provinces.

listings.name: MSF Trailer Manufacturers
listings.current_description: MSF Trailer Manufacturers, trading as MSF Trailers and Steel Works, builds a wide range of trailers in Jan Niemand Park including mobile kitchen, food, livestock, flatbed, luggage and water cart trailers, mobile freezers and mobile toilets, and cold rooms, all built with SABS-approved grade-A steel, and also offers trailer refurbishment and upgrades.

listings.name: Q-SOL Pharma (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Q-SOL Pharma (Pty) Ltd runs a pharmaceutical manufacturing facility on Waltloo Road that has been operating for more than 50 years, having evolved from the original Noristan family business. The SAHPRA GMP-approved, ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 certified plant provides contract manufacturing, packaging and analytical services to more than a dozen customers.

listings.name: Rudi Kruger Accountants (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Rudi Kruger Accountants (Pty) Ltd is an accounting and tax practice established in 2010, serving small and medium businesses with annual financial statements, payroll, tax planning, VAT returns and virtual CFO services. The firm is an accredited reseller of Sage, Xero and QuickBooks accounting software and is registered with SAIPA and CIBA.

listings.name: Wilgers Hospital
listings.current_description: Wilgers Hospital is a 360-bed private hospital in Die Wilgers, Pretoria, one of the largest in the Life Healthcare Group, with an accident and emergency unit and helicopter landing pad, a 46-bed intensive care unit, a 16-bed neonatal ICU and 22 medical and surgical disciplines including cardiology, neurosurgery, orthopaedics, obstetrics and oncology.

listings.name: Aerosud
listings.current_description: Aerosud is a South African aerospace engineering and manufacturing company founded in 1990 and headquartered in Centurion, producing metallic, thermoplastic and composite aircraft components; the company holds a 15-year strategic partnership with Boeing as sole supplier of interior composites and thermoplastic frames, and designed and manufactured interior elements for the Airbus A400M Atlas.

listings.name: Afrit Trailers
listings.current_description: Afrit Trailers is Africa's largest trailer manufacturer, a family-run business based in Rosslyn with more than 60 years in the road transport industry, producing over 6,000 trailers a year -- including side-tippers, end tippers, side curtain trailers, oil and gas tankers and car carriers -- from a 78,000 square metre plant.
